models.long_text: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct (Q4_K_M GGUF, Apache-2.0) via llama.cpp llama-server

risks: FAA delays could impact SpaceX's launch operations and financial performance.
Approximately one-fifth of the company's 2025 revenue came from U.S. government agencies, subjecting it to complex regulations.
Starlink received an order from Brazil's Supreme Court freezing its Brazilian financial assets and preventing financial transactions, potentially affecting operations.
Delays or failures to obtain necessary approvals could materially delay the deployment and commercialization of our Gen2 service.
SpaceX faces regulatory risks that could limit or delay product introductions and expansion.

growth_drivers: Starlink Subscribers grew by 105% year-over-year to approximately 10.3 million in Q ended March 31, 2026.
Revenue increased by $3,788 million, or 49.8%, due to 99.9% growth in Starlink Subscribers.
Space revenue growth is expected to continue to be lower than total company revenue growth.
Space capital expenditures increased significantly, primarily due to investments in Starship launch site infrastructure.
We plan to continue adding new features and functionality while releasing increasingly capable Grok models.
risks: A 100 basis point increase in U.S. interest rates would increase annual interest expense by approximately $200 million.
Net income (loss) for the year ended December 31, 2025 decreased by $5,728 million compared to the prior year.
The Company records a liability when it is probable a loss has been incurred and the amount is reasonably estimable.

growth_drivers: SpaceX deployed 1,041 metric tons to orbit in the six months ended June 30, 2026.
Starlink subscribers grew to 12.0 million from 6.0 million year-over-year.
Revenue increased by $3,743 million, or 91.9%, due to growth in AI, Connectivity, and Space segments.
Revenue from consumer subscribers increased by $1,703 million, or 65.8%, driven by 101.2% growth in Starlink subscribers.
risks: The company will make payments totaling $1,241 million in 2026 and $828 million in 2027 under the Spectrum Credit Agreement.

growth_drivers: Starlink added net more than 1.7 million subscribers in Q2, its best quarter of new customers to date.
Starship aims to deliver over 1 million tons to orbit per year, potentially up to 10 million tons.
Starlink will likely deliver a majority of the world's Internet in less than 10 years.
Revenue in the Connectivity segment was up 66% year-over-year, driven by record net additions of Starlink subscribers.
The company has received over $6 billion in government contracts for the Connectivity segment.
risks: The D3 satellite, 10x more capable than the B2 satellite, could face technical challenges.
Deploying a large number of small Starlink dishes for mobile connectivity may face regulatory hurdles.
